title: Welcome to UNBC - Canada's #1 Small University
description:
UNBC is Canada's # 1 Small University according to Maclean's magazine. Find out more about the UNBC experience: https://unbc4u.unbc.ca

UNBC is also known as Canada's Green University where big opportunities await.The naturally-inspired learning experiences reach way beyond the classroom with research opportunities you will not get anywhere else.

From Argentina to the Ancient Forest—UNBC offers unique experiential learning opportunities and field courses in Northern British Columbia and around the world. 

Our small class sizes mean your studies will be well supported by our world class professors, in fact UNBC has a 1:8 faculty to student ratio.Working closely with faculty means far more research opportunities in your undergraduate education.

At UNBC, a lower cost of living lets you enjoy all the perks of a vibrant city and campus. It all adds up. Plus, 1 in 4 students receive a financial award!

UNBC is located in the heart of BC--the city of Prince George. With a burgeoning restaurant scene, plenty of green space, two junior hockey teams, and a thriving arts and culture community, there's something for everyone. The sun shines almost 300 days a year—perfect for outdoor pursuits. You will feel welcome in @CityofPG. https://youtu.be/LK3kc4cwpRI

Take your first step toward a bright future. 

Find key dates, forms, admissions info and a connection to your own Student Recruitment Officer who will guide you through every step.

Applying to UNBC is easy: https://unbc.ca/admissions

title: International Student Q&A Series: Student life at the University of Sydney (USYD)
description:
If you’re an international student looking to study at the University of Sydney, you may wonder what it’s like moving to Sydney, studying here at USYD and have lots of questions to ask! 

Fear not - we’ve got you covered! We invited a few University of Sydney (USYD) international students and alumni to share their experience and tips with you about how you can start your university life and explore our great city of Sydney. 

In this episode, four University of Sydney (USYD) international students talk about their uni life experience. We cover topics like how to be social and make friends at uni, how to get involved in the community like joining student societies, and some tips for improving your English language skills, but most importantly they share the “golden rule” all University of Sydney (USYD) students need to know! 

If we didn’t answer your question, you can head to our website to find out everything you need to know about studying here at the University of Sydney: https://www.sydney.edu.au

title: TIU Ikebukuro Campus Tour
description:
Welcome to Tokyo International University's Ikebukuro Campus - one of two locations in our English-medium, multi-campus undergraduate degree program. Join us on this virtual tour to learn more about our facilities and the vibrant student life that awaits you right in the heart of Tokyo! 

Our dynamic community brings together over 7,500 students from more than 100 countries and regions, creating a truly global learning environment. At TIU, we offer 4-year English-taught degree programs in Business Economics, Digital Business & Innovation, and International Relations.

Located just minutes from Ikebukuro Station, one of Tokyo's major transportation hubs, our campus combines modern facilities with unparalleled convenience. If you’re interested in living in Japan and joining our renowned E-Track program, TIU's Ikebukuro Campus provides the perfect setting for your academic journey.

TIU E-Track website: https://www.tiu.ac.jp/etrack/
Inquires: etrack-admissions@tiu.ac.jp
